vopros: I run a small service business in Los Angeles and customers keep haggling on price. Who in LA can help me with that?

vyzhimka.tekst:
Yes. What you’re describing is usually a combination of pricing strategy, sales process, and negotiation—not simply “customers are cheap.”

For a small LA service business, I’d start with one of these:

- LA Regional SBDC — probably the best first stop. They provide no-cost, confidential one-on-one business advising, and their services specifically include pricing, competitive assessment, sales/growth planning, and contract negotiations. ([smallbizla.org](https://smallbizla.org/?utm_source=openai))
- SCORE Los Angeles — free mentoring from experienced businesspeople. You can specifically request someone with sales, pricing, or service-business experience rather than getting generic startup advice. ([score.org](https://www.score.org/ca/los-angeles/?utm_source=openai))
- LA BusinessSource Centers — useful if you're inside the City of LA. They offer one-on-one consulting and business-strategy assistance; there are centers serving different parts of the city. ([iconcdc.org](https://www.iconcdc.org/small-business-development-services?utm_source=openai))
- A private pricing/sales consultant — potentially worthwhile if you're already doing meaningful revenue and want someone to work directly on your quotes, packages, scripts, and close rate. I'd look specifically for someone experienced in “value-based selling/pricing” for owner-operated service businesses, rather than a general business coach.

Before paying a consultant, I'd actually take 10–20 recent inquiries and categorize what happened: quoted price, customer objection, whether you discounted, final price, and won/lost. A good advisor can use that to figure out whether your problem is your actual price, how you're presenting it, attracting price-sensitive leads, or giving customers too much room to negotiate.

If you tell me what kind of service business you run (e.g. cleaning, landscaping, photography, contracting, consulting, auto, beauty) and roughly what a typical job costs, I can search LA specifically and give you 3–5 people/organizations I'd consider contacting.
